notes.title: V1.2.4 Version Update
notes.notes:
V1.2.4 Update

① Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where killing an enemy with Calamity, or attempting to play a card when Calamity killed an enemy, could prevent the turn from ending.

Fixed an issue in the Japanese environment where Double Shot could not be played (and caused a freeze) when drawn with enough ammo.

Fixed an issue in the Korean environment where the turn count was not displayed.

Fixed an issue where, if a bottom card was in hand, AoYu could not revert to human form after transforming into Dragon.
② Features
In Custom Mode, the description of "At Ease" has been changed to “Perform 10 unavoidable Enlightens.”

Modified the materials of some textures.

Removed certain cards from the Codex that should not exist there.

notes.title: V1.2.3 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Version 1.2.3 Update



① Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where Antique cards of +2 or higher could appear in the card selection pool.

Fixed a potential freeze when choosing "Treasure Expert".

Fixed an issue where some event texts were not translated.

notes.title: V1.2.2 New Features and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Version 1.2.2 Update

① Features

Added Item Codex to the main menu.

Adjusted the position of the History button. It is now located under “Extra” → “History.”

Added quick-access buttons to join the QQ group and Discord channel in the main menu.

Added a card count indicator to the Deck button, showing the total number of cards in your deck.

Redesigned the controller button layout and adjusted the interface arrangement.

MOD characters can now properly select Inner Skills.

Optimized the structure of update packages. Starting from the next update, the download size for players will be minimized as much as possible.



② Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where Antique cards of +10 or higher did not display the correct rarity.

Fixed an issue where the Clam Yao dropped less than 30 Silver after taking damage.

Fixed an issue where quickly clicking the End Turn button during the “add to hand” animation could cause cards to be retained.

Fixed an issue where using Elemental Mastery failed to double LightningSurge stacks if an enemy was killed by LightningSurge.

Fixed an issue where Fire Hawk could not correctly add cards to the draw pile.

Fixed an occasional issue where the item-use hotkey did not work.

Fixed an issue where the Horse-faced Jailer's status bar could be obscured by Yao soldiers.

Fixed an issue where Yao soldiers' status bars could be obscured by hand cards.

Fixed a possible issue with sound effects not playing correctly.

notes.title: Russian version now available
notes.notes:
In this update, a new language option has been added: Russian.



In version V1.2.0, we added many new items, which can now be purchased in the shop. For details, please refer to the V1.2.0 update notes.



In version V1.2.1, we fixed some bugs and adjusted certain translations. For more information, please refer to the V1.2.1 update notes.





We plan to add the following language options in future updates: French, German, and Spanish.

notes.title: V1.2.1 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where enemies would gain "on dealing damage" bonuses even when attacking a target with the "Ethereal" buff and dealing no actual damage. Examples: Master of Beneficence, Fire Hawk, Bloodthirsty Dog Yao, Bloodthirsty Wolf Yao.

Fixed an issue where the "Solitude" Inner Skill would incorrectly reset Action Points to the maximum when they exceeded the cap.

Fixed an issue where sound effects would still play even when the volume was set to 0.

Fixed an issue where using the Escape Talisman to enter the shop and then performing an SL (save/load) would cause the upper progress bar to display incorrectly.

Fixed an issue where, while having the inner skill Witch Queen and using the card Soul Flame, the effect could be disrupted by enemy actions, preventing the full Strength bonus from applying.

Fixed an incorrect effect description for Iron Hoe. It now correctly displays: Deal 15 damage.

Fixed a freeze issue in the Japanese version of the Bamboo Forest and Refining Events.

Fixed a freeze issue and a wrong Item cost in several Language versions of the Drunkard Events.

Fixed a display bug where the action preview of the River Yao Crab Rider showed “Gain 8 Armor, deal 5 damage” but the armor value appeared as 0.

Adjusted the position of Bowl Yao's clones to prevent their HP bars from being obscured by hand cards.

Added some missing sound effects.

Slightly increased the animation speed of card duplication.

Optimized the display of inner pages in the Yao-guai Codex.




Translation Updates
Added the missing effect description translation for Iron Hoe.

Updated several Japanese translations for cards.

Added the translation for Remove when Dripping Blood has 1 use remaining.

Corrected translation errors in several English card and inner skill effect descriptions.

notes.title: V1.1.1 BUG FIX
notes.notes:
Evil Sword: Now displays the number of turns remaining before reverting to human form after 
 transforming back into its original state.


Bug Fixes
Fixed Mo San a freeze issue caused by using Blade Dance + Limit Break combo.

Fixed Mo San  the card Counter Slash with Bigger costs 1 energy when the draw pile is empty.

Fixed AZi missing sound effects for Death Flame.

Fixed AZi incorrect self-damage numbers for Death Flame.

Fixed AZi Deteriorate not properly doubling Poison and Calamity effects on the Hydra's heads.

Fixed AZi missing tooltip for the Inner Skill Hunting-Mark.

Fixed Sha Er antiques with +1 or higher could not be Copied in the Tricks event.

Fixed Sha Er Inner Skill Treasure Expert would reset a +18 antique back to +14.

Fixed Sha Er Inner Skill Take them All cannot Reserve cards drawn by Buried Quicksand Trap at the end of turn.

Fixed Sha Er Return to Earth not being affected by Broken, Tenacity, or Size Change.

Fixed a text display issue in the Drunkard event.

Fixed a bug where exiting the game while muted would reset the volume to 0 upon re-entry.

Fixed Challenge Furious causing Hydra to gain 120 Strength.

Fixed Wuyou King incorrectly causing “Remove” cards to “Vanish” instead.

Fixed Giant Clam showing incorrect escape buff stacks after being stunned by Sap.

Fixed incorrect condition for the achievement Spider's Lair.

Fixed hand display issues at 800x600 resolution.

Fixed two scenes where buffs were visually obstructed.

Fixed error caused by clicking card rarity filters.

Fixed count error in Old Monkey Yao entry in the Bestiary.

Fixed lore text errors in cards like Night Pearl and Cursed Arrow.

Fixed typos in the Monster Codex.

Fixed "Abandon Run" during death screen could result in duplicate records in statistics.

Fixed incorrect Korean translation for throwable item descriptions.

Fixed translation errors in the Korean description of Action Points.

Fixed decimal display issues across multiple language systems.

notes.title: Korean version now available
notes.notes: "Yao-guai Hunters" is now available in a new language version: Korean.  At the same time, we have updated the V1.1.0 version, added new enemies and cards, and modified a large number of cards. For details, please see the V1.1.0 update announcement.  The game is currently on sale~  We are proofreading other language versions, and will plan to launch Russian, French, German, and Spanish next.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1st June, 2023: New Boss Coming!
notes.notes:
New Content
1. New Yao-Guai General
Wuyou Etiquette Commission

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690210/f5e23c9920d7c8c64cd522957ef478e506eb663c.jpg
This is a band group of three Fox Yao, who are responsible for the rules of ceremonial in Wuyou Kindom.
The last Fox hit by the player would be nominated as "Ace", who would double the effect of her attacks and skills 

2. Now the position of Travelling merchant would be marked on the map.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690210/fe813c1ac7aec21647726b3f9ef975c425c4319b.jpg


Bug Fixs

1. Fix an issue that Blood Shield dealt double damage to the player if became larger.
2. Fix an issue that Show Your Futune would add the Taxes value of Wuyou Manager Yin Xiang.
3. Fix the damage shown on Stab after Azi get the Inner Skill Heartless.
4. Fix an issue causes stuck in the battle with Mirage Yao
5. Now the effect that empty the Action point in Azi's card Potential would be considered as a debuff.


Other Changes
1. Links of Five: Deal 5/7 damage 5 times → 10/12 damage 5 times.
2. Scatter Shot: Deal 7/9 damage to all enemies 2 times → 8/10 damage 2 times.
3. Double Stab: Deal 9/12 damage 2 times → 10/13 damage 2 times.
4. Volley: Deal 7/9 damage per bullet → 8/10 damage per bullet.
5. Bleeding: Lose 5HP → Lose 4 HP.

notes.title: Future update content roadmap
notes.notes:
With the game still being in early access, we had managed to reach a total sale of over 20k! Yeah!
And with the community and player base all wanting a clearer picture of what's to come, here's the list of contents of the future.


1， New Character：Dragon Maiden（Still working on the name）

Well, basically the stereotypical type of , young (kinda around 78 years old, which IS quite young for them), Chinese dragon girl, the type that can command and summon thunder and lightning and all that.The younger sister of Ao Xue. Fights with various spells and dragon wizardry.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690210/6bb6dbe3e616b1ef5dc91a93ee05a4413a0b3131.jpg
（Character design concept）

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690210/8d8e2179290f5d92c1360a8b3ababf09ebba18f6.jpg
（Character demo screenshot）

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690210/8da95f7d728cd590862b01ac7aa673574cbe4b80.jpg
（Character demo screenshot）


2，Creature encyclopedia and backstories

Will be making a sort of a monster/creature encyclopedia as well as a bit of a short write up on the background and backstory of the Yao Guais.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690210/24745d21da45c4a9a690b988285d1e2cb89975b8.jpg
（Encyclopeida sample, still a work in progress）

3，Steam workshop
Though even the dev (since this is the translator typing) have no idea on anyone that is out there that could make some mod for the game, but due to popular demand, Steam Workshop will be added.

4，OST Album
Ah yes, this one is to be sold, though....how much? Maybe we are gonna tweak some of the OSTs and even make an album cover of sorts, will be out very soon.

5，Customized mode and daily challenge
Got the feeling that there won't be a lot of players that are keen with this kind of things but will be adding these two mods in time.
Will be out soon, too.

6，Additional Contents
Because of certain gut feeling about the game getting a bit too repetitive
So we have decided to add a fourth boss per chapter (basically a miniboss)
This will take some time...
Actual, actual boss will be 3 per chapter, and as of now chapter 2/3 is still missing one, so will be adding that too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690210/10e0dff8f33c17f7ad81db7c4cbf2c4d4b9f1d52.jpg
（The Yao Guai design-in-progress）

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690210/baac7ad8c6bcc41d6717d07645c07a62607d6e42.jpg
（The Yao Guai design-in-progress）

7，Uncertain contents
Not too sure about the addition of another chapter, more or less will be making those, but might get distracted with the designing of those new action cards instead....
After we are done with character 4....maybe we will be working on a fifth character...but we are really not sure if new character would increase sales...is there really people out there that wants new character? 
Really, really want to add in more character (but character design is hard)...
That would be more or less it....unless the dev had forgotten something...will be updating this log if there is anything...



OH, right !

8，Battlelogs and Player stats
Basically a log on what cards had been used and all that, almost done with this too.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 11th May 2023
notes.notes:
New cards for Azi:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690210/72278bc33af25c508f60aa100d2e419a540eeef9.jpg

Snakes Coming (Cost 2):
Play all the Spirit Snakes you Have.

Spirit Connection (Cost 2): 
Add 1 Summon location. Draw 2 cards.

Die But Not Dead (Cost 1): 
Revive all Summon died last turn.

Links of Five (Cost 0): 
Deal 5 damage to all enemies 5 times. Cannot be played unless you have at least 5 kinds of Summon.

Twins (Cost 0): 
Generate two Spirit Snake in your hand, Disperse.

Foster (Cost 0): 
Lose 2 HP. All Summon gain 1 Spirit Power, Disperse.

Disaster Befallen (Cost 1): 
Deal 7 damage. Trigger the Disaster of target enemy.

Flick the Sleeve (Cost 1): 
Gain 4 Armor. Summon a Spirit Snake.


New Inner Skills for Azi:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690210/f9cc0d15e82ac9848032f28c66ca48e53b3e53aa.jpg

Deadly Venom:
Poison triggers before enemies attack.

Painful Curse
Give 3 stacks of Fragile after Disaster triggered.

Sticky Fluid:
Attacks of Jade Toad and Gecko give additional 4 stacks of Poison.

Hard Carapace:
Red Scorpion and Tortoise have 1 additional Spirit Power.

Fleshy Worm:
When a Centipede or Ice Silkworm die, other Summon gain 5 stacks of Divine Point.


Card and Inner Skill Changes:

Mo San

The Last Stand: 
Previous effect: All cards in hand cost -1/0. Gain 3 stacks of Fragile and Broken. Disperse.
New effect: All cards in hand cost -1/0. Gain 2/1 stacks of Fragile and Broken. Disperse.

Iron Fist: 
Previous effect: Deal 7/9 damage to one enemy, repeat X times.
New effect: Deal 8/10 damage to one enemy, repeat X times.

Azi

Ghost Moth: 
Previous effect: Attack 3/3, Give gives all enemies 1/2 stacks of Fragile when played.
New effect: Attack 3/5, Give gives all enemies 2/2 stacks of Fragile when played.

Spiritual Barrier: 
Previous effect: Gain 7/10 Armor, repeat X times.
New effect: Gain 8/10 Armor, repeat X times.

Back Stab:
Previous effect: Deals 9/11 damage, Innate, Mark, and Disperse.
New effect: Deals 7/9 damage and 1/2 stack of Fragile, Innate, Mark, and Disperse.

Vigor Extraction+:
Previous effect: Take 1 Spirit Power from each Summon, convert it to the same amount of Action Point.
New effect: Take 1 Spirit Power from each Summon, convert it to the same amount plus one of Action Point, Disperse.

Insect Language: 
Cost 1 → 0

Snake Taming: 
Previous effect: All spirit snakes have +2 attack power.
New effect: All spirit snakes have +2 attack power and +1 Spirit Power.

Insect Flute:
CD 1 → 2

Inscrutable:
Now only available after Yao-Guai King.


Other Changes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690210/3733982375fe2af2cf976980e7dcb7227078c4cf.jpg
1. General Yin Xiang will always use "taxation" at its first turn.
2. Fix the effect of the event "Man in bucket" in high Yao Aura.
3. Try some optimization for Azi in case of lag.
